messages:
marco: hey everyone, Marco here — first week! I'm trying to get my kube contexts set up. `kubectl config get-contexts` only shows `local` and `ci` but the onboarding doc mentions a `redwood-dev` context. Not sure if I need to run `aws eks update-kubeconfig` or something else. Who should I bug for RBAC/namespace access?
anya-dev: welcome Marco :wave: For EKS we usually run `aws eks update-kubeconfig --name redwood-dev --region us-west-2 --alias redwood-dev` (if you're on AWS). After that `kubectl config get-contexts` should show `redwood-dev`. If you use GCP let us know.
marco: thx — I ran update-kubeconfig but still don't see the namespace `team-marco` in the context. `kubectl get namespaces` lists a lot but I get `Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden` when trying to list pods in `team-marco`.
infra-bot: created ticket INF-8675 for user marco: request RoleBinding and namespace quota check. Assigned to sam-eng.
sam-eng: assigning this. Marco, can you paste the output of `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-marco` and `groups` from the SSO token (or your SSO email)? Also are you joining as contractor or fulltime? We bind different groups.
marco: `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-marco` -> no. SSO email is marco@redwood.ai and my SSO groups are ["employees","new-hires"]. I'm fulltime.
sam-eng: looks like you aren't in `redwood-developers` yet. I'll create a RoleBinding `rb-marco-onboard` in namespace `team-marco` and add you to the `redwood-developers-onboard` group so you can start. Give it a minute and re-run `kubectl auth can-i`.
k8s-oncall: FYI if you still see a cached token, run `aws sso login --profile redwood` (or `gcloud auth login`), then `kubectl config use-context redwood-dev`. We had a caching issue last week with the SSO plugin.
marco: after a few mins `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-marco` -> yes. `kubectl get pods -n team-marco` -> "No resources found." so access is good. Two quick follow-ups: 1) how to request secrets access? 2) how do I get the context to default to my namespace so I don't have to `-n team-marco` every time?
anya-dev: 1) secrets: open ticket -> add `secrets-read` role or request a service account if you need programmatic access. We'll need justification + TTL. 2) to set default namespace on a context: `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=team-marco` (or `kubectl config set-context redwood-dev --namespace=team-marco` for only that context).
marco: awesome, did `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=team-marco` and now it defaults. Thanks for the quick help!
sam-eng: welcome aboard. I've updated INF-8675 with RoleBinding details and set the ticket to resolved. If you need resource quotas increased for your dev namespace open a new ticket and tag @sam-eng.
infra-bot: INF-8675 updated: RoleBinding rb-marco-onboard created, status resolved.
marco: one last tiny thing: my kubeconfig merged credentials from two clusters and I had an older `auth-provider` entry pointing at an expired OIDC provider which caused a confusing "Unauthorized" earlier. If anyone else hits this, remove stale `users` entries or run `kubectl config view --minify --flatten > ~/.kube/config` to regenerate a clean kubeconfig.
anya-dev: good call documenting that. I'll add a note to the onboarding doc about cleaning stale kubeconfig entries and the SSO login step.
marco: thanks everyone, feeling set up now :smile:
